armsrack: Equipping the hunters with arms allow them to go after larger prey.
bellows: Large bellows powered by strong animals increases the airflow for the fire allowing it to reach higher temperatures.
guard booth: Relying on professional guards allows the workers to focus on production without worrying about outside interference.
beehives: Improved beehives together with protective gear for the beekeepers makes beekeeping more efficient.
wood rack: Storage facilities and cranes for supplying firewood for fire-setting in the mine.
warehouse: Upgrade the storehouse to a larger warehouse. Upon completion the storehouse turns into a warehouse with more space, as well as the possibility to be expanded further.
crane lift: Shelves and cranes to lift goods allow for better stacking and more storage.
toolshed: Equipping the workers with proper tools will greatly increase their efficiency.
productivity 1: Improve building and processes to increase the productivity of its Production Recipes, giving increased output in the primary output of each recipe.
productivity 2: Further improve building and processes to increase the productivity of its Production Recipes, giving increased output in the primary output of each recipe.
productivity 3: Further improve building and processes to increase the productivity of its Production Recipes, giving increased output in the primary output of each recipe.
premium production: Enable production of premium products whose production require extraordinary skill, care and the highest quality equipment.
crazing mill: Mill for curshing the ore into a fine, sand-like powder.
